name: Buck Rückversicherung
personality: He calls a bold play and immediately asks for a second opinion.
visual_intent: Long curved blob, anxious wide eyes looking sideways, clenched internal teeth; small old brown leather helmet OPEN FACE no bars, tiny mustard collar; both short goo hands carefully cradle one laced brown football
biography: He calls a bold play and immediately asks for a second opinion. His HyperNorm playbook allows only forward progress or personal failure. He clutches the ball while translating a simple neighbourly request into a safely reversible instruction. A dissonant card proposing that asking for help could itself be leadership sits inside his helmet. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Er übernimmt Verantwortung. Vorbehaltlich der Rückversicherung.

name: Mona Mauerwerk
personality: She provides protection with the patience of a locked filing cabinet.
visual_intent: Very wide low rectangular splat with thick round lobes, strong lashes, pursed toothless determined mouth; navy collar and two small mustard shoulder pads, ink belly dominant; hands spread like an immovable barrier
biography: She provides protection with the patience of a locked filing cabinet. She guards the service corridor, judging visitors as protected or exposed. Her small shoulder pads have stopped more frightened apologies than opponents. She is starting to suspect that a barrier can also be a place to lean against. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Mauer steht. Anlehnen ist nach Feierabend gestattet.

name: Skip Luftpost
personality: He is certain the next pass will finally be addressed to him.
visual_intent: Upright thin tapering splat with uplifted crest, ecstatic asymmetrical open grin, upper teeth only; tiny mustard shoulder stripe, two giant leather receiving gloves raised one beside each cheek, empty hands
biography: He is certain the next pass will finally be addressed to him. He waits for permission to catch good news, which the building office invariably throws somewhere else. His empty gloves preserve the shape of a future promotion. A card about shared credit made him look at the neighbours instead of the ceiling. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Er ist anspielbar. Die Verwaltung bestreitet den Zugang.

name: Dora Durchbruch
personality: She carries the entire offence and would like that noted.
visual_intent: Compact asymmetric diamond blob, side quiff, lashes and offended raised brow, closed compressed mouth; short mustard scarf, navy elbow patch; one football tucked securely under goo arm, other arm pointing inward to self
biography: She carries the entire offence and would like that noted. She carries the building's errands under one arm and divides every task into hers or inexplicably also hers. The tucked football is much easier to protect than her afternoon. She has begun leaving small jobs for residents eager to be useful. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Sie trägt das Team. Eine Aufwandsentschädigung ist nicht vorgesehen.

name: Tank Zuständigkeit
personality: He tackles uncertainty even when it is standing perfectly still.
visual_intent: Tall broad domed splat with tiny split ink crest, stern heavy white eyes, lopsided gaping bark and two upper teeth; old leather ear guards, navy knit collar, holds one small scratched oval blocking pad against his flank
biography: He tackles uncertainty even when it is standing perfectly still. He supervises the stairwell and tackles every idea classified as uncontrolled movement. The oval pad is chiefly there to soften encounters he insists were unavoidable. A contradictory card has taught him to ask one question before blocking the answer. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Für den Zusammenstoß liegt eine Zuständigkeit vor.

name: Pip Extraversuch
personality: He believes a specialist is someone allowed to be nervous in only one direction.
visual_intent: Round small-bodied but equal overall-size splat with long upright ink curl; nervous eyes upward, trembling toothless smile; navy skullcap and mustard collar, holds one tall old-fashioned leather kicking boot with no human foot inside
biography: He believes a specialist is someone allowed to be nervous in only one direction. He is the designated specialist whenever the building needs someone else to be nervous. The empty kicking boot promises precision without supplying a foot. He keeps a second chance for residents whose first attempt was watched too closely. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Sein Spezialgebiet ist der nächste Versuch. Der vorige ist noch anhängig.
